_comment: NonParallel merch. Each product is one design on the tees listed in `colors`. `design.uploadId` is an image already in Printify's uploads; `design.file` is a PNG in this folder to upload. Prices are in cents and include US shipping. Edit and push: the Printify workflow creates/updates the products and commits lib/merch-catalog.json plus the mockups.
details: 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (solid colors)
